writeup.thesis: Himax scores 41, a Sell, held down mainly by growth, which scores 0 on a TTM revenue decline of 14.7%, with growth slowed by 30.7 pp from the previous quarter. Quality is middling at 41: gross margin is 24.4%, operating margin just 1.2%, and free cash flow margin is -1.5%, though dilution is minimal with the diluted share count up 0.1% year on year. The balance sheet is the clear strength at 92, with cash slightly exceeding debt (cash-to-debt of 1.01) and net cash covering 14.3 years of the current burn. Trend scores 43: the shares are up 49.9% from 12 months ago to 1 month ago, but the price is 50.4% below its 52-week high and 10.5% below its 50-day average. News is mildly positive at 58 after WiseEye won a slot in Alibaba's Qwen smart glasses; valuation could not be scored.
key_risks: Revenue is shrinking, with a TTM revenue decline of 14.7% and growth slowed by 30.7 pp.
Operating margin of 1.2% and negative free cash flow leave little room if sales weaken further.
The share price is 50.4% below its 52-week high and trails both SPY and QQQ over the last 126 trading days.
Q3 results on November 5, 2026 could reset expectations; EAR export licensing remains a standing risk.
